message.content: The shortness of breath started coming back just a few days after I had that fluid drained. I’m not sure how to put a number on it, but it’s definitely making it hard to breathe again. I’ve been dealing with this cough and trouble breathing for about two weeks now. I did feel a bit better right after they took out that 1.5 liters of milky fluid, but it didn't last long. I’ve smoked for a long time, too.
